text:
sara: Heads up — seeing OOB drops in us-central1 rack r12. Multiple BMC watchdog kicks in the last 20m, nodes rebooting and secure-boot bit flipping intermittently. GPU pools not coming back.
mike: How bad is provisioning? are pods stuck Pending or nodes NotReady?
jonas: Pods Pending; kube shows nodes NotReady/Network. Autoscaler is churny — it spins new instances but they fail provisioning because BMC doesn't stay up long enough to PXE.
tilly: Jump host (kvm-jumphost1) logs show a lot of 502/504s to BMC proxy during the same window. sounds like connection churn rather than single firmware bricking.
jonas: Pasted quick oobctl output:
```
$ oobctl watch r12 --last 50
[2026-03-20T16:02:11Z] rack r12 bmc[10.0.12.3] watchdog: kick, reason="dhcp-renew-failed"
[2026-03-20T16:02:12Z] rack r12 bmc[10.0.12.3] secureboot: toggled -> on
[2026-03-20T16:02:13Z] rack r12 bmc[10.0.12.4] watchdog: kick, reason="ip-lease-conflict"
[2026-03-20T16:02:14Z] rack r12 bmc[10.0.12.5] reboot: soft
```
sara: +1 that's what we see. DHCP renews failing then BMC watchdog resets. suspect recent BMC fw 2.4.0 pushed in rolling update earlier today.
infra-bot: deploy-bmc-firmware v2.4.0 started by auto-roller at 2026-03-20T15:35:02Z targeting racks: r10,r11,r12,r13
mike: If it's the fw, we should stop the rollout and roll back r12 immediately. also quarantine the rack from scheduler so it doesn't attempt allocations.
jonas: Suggested commands:
```
# quarantine rack
fleetctl annotate rack r12 outage=true --reason "OOB churn"
# stop rollout
deployctl cancel deploy-bmc-firmware v2.4.0
# rollback plan
deployctl promote image bmc-fw-2.3.1 --target-rack r12
```
sara: Agree. Also we need a temporary smart-router rule to avoid scheduling user jobs to us-central1-gpu while we triage — traffic is spilling and causing cost spike (autoscaler is spinning extra on-demand capacity).
tilly: I'll apply the temporary route: `smart-router set-priority region=us-central1 weight=0.2` to bias away. will monitor impact.
mike: Cost note: billing team already flagged a spike in preemptible fallbacks -> on-demand; estimate +18% for last hour. we'll track with finance.
jonas: After rollback, run a small canary on r10 first (non-gpu) for 10 nodes, then r12. we should also validate DHCP lease server config because logs show lease conflicts.
sara: Can someone open an incident and add runbook steps? I'll own communications. We need runbook: stop rollout, quarantine rack, rollback fw, run DHCP sanity checks, re-provision kvm-jump, verify secure-boot sticky bit.
mike: I'll open the incident and add oncall rotation. linking postmortem template.
tilly: Temporary mitigation applied, quarantined r12 nodes from scheduler. monitoring jump host and oob metrics.
infra-bot: incident #INC-20260320-042 created by mike. channel: #inc-4201234567
sara: Thanks team — keep replies here with short updates. once rollback confirmed we'll lift quarantine and schedule a controlled canary with staged DHCP checks. :thumbsup:
mike: ack
jonas: running DHCP lease audit now, will update in ~10m
tilly: watching kvm-jump logs, will restart jump service if connections drop again :hourglass:
